bma.title: BMA — Multilingual AI Mental Health Companion
bma.description: Hybrid conversational system combining a fine-tuned DistilBERT classifier (intents & emotions) with a generative Google Gemini model featuring automated multi-model fallback for high availability.
bma.highlights: Priority distress signal detection with emergency routing (lines 15/3114) • Full trilingual support (Arabic, French, English)
bma.archOverview: A resilient hybrid AI architecture integrating local edge NLP classification for rapid distress screening with an intelligent multi-model cloud fallback mechanism to guarantee continuous, empathetic conversation support.

steps.title: Trilingual Input & Script Normalization
steps.desc: Preprocesses user queries in Arabic (with diacritic handling), French, and English with token length gating.

steps.title: DistilBERT Intent & Distress Classifier
steps.desc: Fine-tuned PyTorch DistilBERT model running on low-latency inference (<45ms) to detect emotional state, severity level, and crisis indicators.

steps.title: Safety Interceptor & Emergency Routing
steps.desc: Immediate rule-based interceptor that bypasses generative models to dispatch helpline resources (e.g. 3114 / SOS) if acute distress is detected.

steps.title: Multi-Model Fallback Generative Engine
steps.desc: Calls Google Gemini API with automated multi-model cascade (Gemini 2.5 Flash -> Gemini 1.5 Flash -> Local empathetic fallback) for 99.9% resilience.

steps.title: Context Buffer & Zero-PII Session Storage
steps.desc: SQLite conversational history with sliding token window and privacy-compliant ephemeral memory.

fraudguard.title: FraudGuard — Banking Fraud Detection System
fraudguard.description: Machine Learning pipeline tailored for highly imbalanced transactions (0.17% fraud rate) with rigorous optimization of PR-AUC and ROC-AUC curves.
fraudguard.highlights: Full explainability using SHAP values and a Flask web application for real-time transaction scoring and risk analysis
fraudguard.archOverview: An end-to-end Machine Learning pipeline specifically engineered for extreme class imbalance (0.17% fraud rate), featuring cost-sensitive ensemble modeling, PR-AUC optimization, and full regulatory explainability using SHAP values.

steps.title: High-Throughput Ingestion Stream
steps.desc: Ingests incoming credit card transactions (PCA features V1-V28, normalized amounts, time deltas).

steps.title: Preprocessing & Robust Scaling
steps.desc: RobustScaler transforms heavily skewed transaction amounts while filtering financial outliers.

steps.title: Class Imbalance Resampling (SMOTE-ENN)
steps.desc: Combines Synthetic Minority Oversampling (SMOTE) with Edited Nearest Neighbors (ENN) to resolve the severe 0.17% imbalance without overfitting.

steps.title: Cost-Sensitive Ensemble Classifier
steps.desc: XGBoost & LightGBM ensemble tuned with custom asymmetric penalty matrix to penalize false negatives (missed frauds) 50x heavier than false positives.

steps.title: SHAP Explainability & REST API Scoring
steps.desc: Real-time TreeExplainer computes Shapley feature contributions in <25ms, returning fraud risk scores and top risk factors to banking auditors.

intelej.title: IntelEJ Medical Center — Healthcare Platform & AI Assistant
intelej.description: Full-stack medical platform with role-based access control dashboards (Doctor and Patient portals) and automated online appointment management.
intelej.highlights: Integration of Al-Rāzī intelligent assistant for pre-diagnosis and request triage in Arabic, French, and English
intelej.archOverview: A full-stack clinical platform powered by React 18, Supabase, and Postgres Row Level Security, integrated with the Al-Rāzī intelligent medical triage assistant for symptom intake and appointment automation.

steps.title: Role-Based Client Portals (React 18)
steps.desc: Dedicated interfaces for Patients (symptoms intake, appointments, history) and Doctors (clinical queue, calendar, triage summary).

steps.title: Al-Rāzī Trilingual Triage Engine
steps.desc: Interactive clinical dialogue system in Arabic, French, and English assessing symptom severity and recommending relevant medical specialties.

steps.title: JWT Auth & Postgres Row-Level Security (RLS)
steps.desc: Enforces strict HIPAA/GDPR-compliant data segregation so patients only access their own records and doctors only access assigned patient charts.

steps.title: Real-Time WebSocket Sync Engine
steps.desc: Supabase real-time channels instantly notifying doctors of incoming consultations and patient slot bookings.

steps.title: Auditing & Structured Intake Storage
steps.desc: Relational Postgres schemas storing structured pre-consultation reports to reduce physician intake time by up to 60%.

q1.question: What is your primary profile and area of expertise?
q1.answer: Final year Master's student (M2) in Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and Advanced Applications at Ibn Tofail University (Kenitra). I specialize in Machine Learning models, NLP (Transformers), distributed data architectures (Hadoop, Spark), and model explainability (SHAP).

q2.question: Are you available for an End-of-Studies (PFE) Internship?
q2.answer: Yes, absolutely! I am actively seeking an End-of-Studies Internship (PFE) starting early February 2027 as an AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, or Big Data Engineer.

q3.question: Which technologies are you most proficient in?
q3.answer: AI & Data: Python, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Transformers, SHAP, Hadoop, Spark, SQL, PostgreSQL. Software & Backend: Flask, FastAPI, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, C++, Java, and Linux environments.

q4.question: What major projects highlight your skills?
q4.answer: 1) BMA: Mental health AI companion with DistilBERT and Google Gemini. 2) FraudGuard: Banking fraud detection on imbalanced transactions (0.17% frauds) with SHAP and Flask. 3) IntelEJ Medical Center: Clinical platform with trilingual intelligent assistant Al-Rāzī.
